{{Quote|Phoenix Squadron, keep those fighters busy. Green Squadron, attack the lead destroyer.|Captain Hera Syndulla, to Alliance squadrons regarding the ''Dark Omen''|<ref name="Zero Hour" />}}
The '''''Dark Omen''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Imperial Navy]] that was active by [[2 BBY]]. During the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Lothal campaign]] against rebel cells such as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Phoenix Cell|Phoenix Group]] and the [[Spectres]], the ''Dark Omen'' was under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Captain]] [[Corf Ferno]] and assigned to [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]]. At the campaign's [[Battle of Atollon]], the ''Dark Omen'' led a [[Dark Omen's squadron|squadron]] of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], or ISDs, until the arrival of Thrawn aboard the [[flagship]] ISD ''[[Chimaera]]''. During the engagement, the ''Dark Omen'' was damaged by [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] and participated in the [[orbital bombardment]] of the [[Chopper Base|rebel base]], though survivors managed to escape through a gap between it and the ''Chimaera''.

Following the battle, the ''Dark Omen'' was repaired and continued to serve Ferno, who was promoted to [[Vice Admiral|vice admiral]] and selected to serve as a member of the [[Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military]] by [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)|Supreme Commander]] [[Cassio Tagge]]. The ''Dark Omen'' and the remains of the Seventh Fleet were tasked with patrolling areas of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. During the pan-[[Galaxy|galactic]] conflict, the ''Dark Omen'' participated in an Imperial [[ambush of a rebel convoy at Derra]] alongside Vice Admiral [[Rae Sloane]] and the [[Vigilance (Imperial-class)|''Vigilance'']]. Following this, the ''Dark Omen'' was among the [[Starship|ships]] present at the [[Battle of Endor]], which resulted in the destruction of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] and the [[death]]s of [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].

In the battle's aftermath, the ''Dark Omen'' was dispatched by Grand Admiral Sloane to the [[factory world]] [[Kuat]], taking part in the [[Defense of Kuat]] against [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force|forces]]. The failed defensive operation by Imperial [[Kuati Imperial fleet|forces]] to protect the [[Kuat shipyards]] hastened the end of the war, which ended soon after with the [[Battle of Jakku]] in [[5 ABY]]. The ''Dark Omen'' was extensively mentioned by [[historian]] and [[Resistance]] paramilitary member [[Beaumont Kin]] in [[35 ABY]] in his [[book]], ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''. Files and information were recovered from the ''Dark Omen'', including an image of Grand Admiral Thrawn in the [[far galaxy]] in [[9 ABY]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Admiral Konstantine, deploy the fleet to these coordinates.|Grand Admiral Thrawn orders his Star Destroyers, including the ''Dark Omen'', to Atollon|<ref name="Zero Hour" />}}
The ''Dark Omen''<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" /> was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Zero Hour" /> It was 1,600 [[meter]]s long<ref name="Length note" /> and was outfitted with four port and four starboard quad [[turbolaser]] [[turret]]s, ventral [[cannon]]s, a [[hangar]] bay,<ref name="Zero Hour" /> two [[ISD-72x shield generator dome]]s,<ref name="Shield note" /> and a [[solar ionization reactor]].<ref name="Equipment note" /> Behind its [[Color|light gray]] [[hull]], the ''Dark Omen'' was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] system<ref name="Zero Hour" /> and three [[Destroyer-I ion engine]]s with four smaller [[Gemon-4 ion engine]]s.<ref name="Equipment note" /> The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] (ISD)<ref name="Rise" /> was also stocked with a [[tractor beam targeting array]]<ref name="Targeting note" /> situated above the [[starship]]'s [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and between the two [[deflector shield generator dome]]s.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

==History==
===Battle of Atollon===
====Onset of the Battle of Atollon====
{{Quote|Commander Sato. We have Imperial Star Destroyers incoming.|A rebel pilot warns Commander Sato about the incoming squadron of Star Destroyers|<ref name="Zero Hour" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Atollon.png|thumb|right|290px|The ''Dark Omen'' (lead destroyer) and four other Star Destroyers arrive over Atollon.]]
The ''Dark Omen'' served in the [[Galactic Empire]] as part of the [[Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. By the [[time]] of the [[Lothal campaign]],<ref name="Zero Hour" /> the ''Dark Omen'' was under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Captain]] [[Corf Ferno]] as part of [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]].<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" /> After Thrawn pinpointed the location of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Chopper Base]] on<ref name="Zero Hour" /> the [[Lothal sector]] [[planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Atollon]]<ref name="Zero Hour" /> in [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> he had [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]] dispatch<ref name="Zero Hour" /> a [[Dark Omen's squadron|squadron]]<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" /> of five ''Imperial I''-class [[Star Destroyer]]s from [[Lothal]],<ref name="Zero Hour" /> another planet in that [[sector]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The Star Destroyers included Ferno's ''Dark Omen'',<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" /> which was the [[Command ship|lead]] [[destroyer]]<ref name="Zero Hour" /> of the [[squadron]].<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" />

With the arrival of [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] in the [[Atollon system]], the Alliance's [[Phoenix Cell]]–which was headquartered at Chopper Base and preparing to launch an [[attack on Lothal]] alongside their reinforcements from the [[Massassi Group]] rebel cell<ref name="Zero Hour" /> of the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] elsewhere in the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" />–scrambled to evacuate their base of operations and disperse their [[fleet]]. Thrawn's [[flagship]], the ''[[Chimaera]]'', then arrived. Responding to rebel maneuvers, Thrawn ordered his ships to deploy [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] and to reinforce the center of their formation. Meanwhile, Captain [[Hera Syndulla]] ordered the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]s of [[Phoenix Squadron]] to clear the Imperial [[TIE series|fighters]] while she commanded the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] to attack the ''Dark Omen''.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

====Continued actions at Atollon====
{{Quote|Green group, clear out for another pass.|Green Leader instructs his squadron to make another bombing run on the ''Dark Omen''|<ref name="Zero Hour" />}}
[[File:Dark-Omen.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Dark Omen'' sustains minimal damage from an attack by Green Squadron.]]
After Phoenix Squadron cleared a path, a contingent of Green Squadron [[bomber]]s broke through Imperial lines and made a run for the ''Dark Omen''. [[Green Leader (Atollon)|Green Leader]] ordered the bombers to arm their [[proton torpedo]]es and to follow him during the bombing run, after which the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter]]s managed to fly over the ''Dark Omen''{{'s}} dorsal hull and release a total of four [[warhead]]s, causing three explosions. The rebel bombers then moved to the ship's portside to conduct another bombing pass but were forced to break off when one of their bombers was destroyed by attacking TIE [[Starfighter|fighters]] and the ''Dark Omen''{{'s}} port batteries.<ref name="Zero Hour" /> Overall, the ''Dark Omen'' was lightly damaged by Green Squadron.<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" />

Following the joint destruction of [[Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor]] and the rebel flagship, the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]] ''[[Phoenix Nest]]'', [[Jedi]] [[Lieutenant Commander]] [[Ezra Bridger]] escaped to summon reinforcements. Thrawn subsequently reorganized his formation, and all of his Star Destroyers launched an [[orbital bombardment]] of Chopper Base<ref name="Zero Hour" /> to break rebel morale<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" /> after [[Alliance Military|rebel forces]] had fled to the surface of Atollon. Despite the bombardment, Chopper Base's [[deflector shield generator]] held firm.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

[[File:Dark-Omen-attacks.png|thumb|right|285px|The ''Dark Omen'' fires upon rebel ships escaping the blockade.]]
After the subsequent ground assault by Thrawn to capture the rebel leadership and the destruction of the [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] ''[[Constrainer]]'' by [[Mandalorian]] [[Clan Wren|reinforcements]] brought by Bridger, the last remaining rebel ships fled Atollon's surface and moved toward the Imperial [[blockade]]. The rebel ships pushed through a gap between the ''Chimaera'' and the ''Dark Omen''. Although several rebel ships, including a [[CR90 corvette]], were destroyed in this final push, the remaining rebel starships escaped the blockade and jumped into [[hyperspace]].<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" />

====Atollon's aftermath====
{{Quote|While Captain Ferno would eventually be promoted through the ranks and escaped relatively unscathed, since his ship was not present at Lothal due to ongoing repairs, Captain Gilad Pellaeon–who survived the disastrous Lothal engagement–does not appear to have been immediately promoted in the same way, despite his obvious talents.|Beaumont Kin in ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire'', writing of the aftermath of the battles of Atollon and Lothal|<ref name="Rise" />}}
Following the Battle of Atollon, the Seventh Fleet and [[Spectres|rebel]] [[Lothal resistance group|forces]] again clashed at the [[Liberation of Lothal]]<ref name="Rise" /> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> where the Empire was driven off the planet. The ''Dark Omen'' was absent from the engagement, as it was undergoing repairs elsewhere. Consequently, Ferno's career remained largely unaffected by the defeat, allowing him to continue advancing through the ranks despite the setback.<ref name="Rise" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin]] and the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]], a power vacuum emerged within the [[Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military]]. Due to this void, [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)|Supreme Commander]] [[Grand General]] [[Cassio Tagge]] promoted Ferno to [[Vice Admiral]] and placed him in command of the final remnants of the Seventh Fleet. By this time, the fleet was reduced to a handful of [[capital ship]]s and support vessels that were not present during Lothal's liberation from the Empire, including the ''Dark Omen''. Ferno was subsequently tasked with patrolling areas in the Outer Rim. This action allowed Tagge to place Thrawn's loyalists together to avoid issues with others in the Imperial fleet that believed these loyalists were compromised by their close association with the missing<ref name="Rise" /> [[Chiss]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> grand admiral.<ref name="Rise" />

===Ambush at Derra IV===
{{Quote|Though the Rebel Alliance were not able to ascertain exactly what happened at Derra IV, we know now that the ''Vigilance'' took the lead–given it was Sloane's plan–but was ably supported by the ''Dark Omen'' and, most importantly, the Interdictor cruiser ''Retention'' that helped isolate the convoy and enabled its destruction.|The passage regarding Derra IV in Kin's ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise" />}}
[[File:Vigilance_ISD.png|thumb|left|260px|The ''Dark Omen'' participated in the Derra IV ambush alongside the ''Vigilance'' (pictured in the foreground).]]
For a period of time prior to the [[Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Rise" /> in [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> the Rebel Alliance had been transporting supplies through the [[Derra system]] in the Outer Rim. The Alliance [[convoy]]s contained an array of [[weapon]]s, equipment, [[Foodstuff|food]], and medicine that were in need by various rebel cells throughout [[the galaxy]]. In coordination with the remains of the Seventh Fleet, Vice Admiral [[Rae Sloane]] deduced the most probable possible rebel [[Hyperspace route|shipping routes]] in the [[Expansion Region]] and honed in on the astronomical object [[Derra IV]] from a selection of candidates. As Sloane planned the operation, her ISD [[Vigilance (Imperial-class)|''Vigilance'']] led Imperial forces with support from the ''Dark Omen'' and the [[Interdictor]] cruiser ''[[Retention]]''.<ref name="Rise" />

The ''Retention'' crucially aided in isolating the rebel convoy and allowing for its destruction. The [[Ambush of a rebel convoy at Derra|ambush]] of the convoy and [[Renegade Squadron]] at Derra IV was considered a near-perfect victory by the Imperial Navy. The cutting off of the Rebel Alliance's supply line by the ''Dark Omen'', ''Vigilance'', and other Imperial forces significantly increased the probability of a larger Imperial strategic victory, which was carried out by [[Imperial officer]]s and forces that were partially banished from standard Imperial operations.<ref name="Rise" />

===Battle of Endor===
{{Quote|Admiral Sloane and the ''Vigilance'' were present, as were Admiral Versio’s ''Eviscerator'', Vice Admiral Ferno’s ''Dark Omen'', and Admiral Montferrat with the ''Devastator''. These ships and their commanders had seen extensive action against the Rebel Alliance across the entirety of the war.|Beaumont Kin writing on the presence of experienced ships and commanders at Endor in ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise" />}}
[[File:HesGoodButNotTHATGood-ROTJHD.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The ''Dark Omen'' was one of a number of Star Destroyers present at Endor.]]
In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Ferno and the ''Dark Omen'' participated in briefings along with the massing Imperial forces in preparation for anticipated action at the [[Endor|Forest Moon of Endor]]<ref name="Rise" /> in the Outer Rim's [[Moddell sector]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The ''Dark Omen'' was accompanied by other commanders and ships also considered experienced, including Sloane's ''Vigilance'', Admiral [[Jhared Montferrat]]'s ''[[Devastator]]'', and [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] Admiral [[Garrick Versio]]'s ''[[Eviscerator]]''. Additionally, they were complemented by slightly less experienced [[officer]]s and ships, such as [[Commodore]] [[Scaanos]] and his [[Steadfast (Imperial-class)|''Steadfast'']] and Captain [[Inalis]] with the ''[[Interrogator]]''. Other officers and capital ships included [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett]] and the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|Star Dreadnought]] flagship ''[[Executor]]'',<ref name="Rise" /> the [[battlecruiser]] ''[[Pride of Tarlandia]]'',<ref name="Levers">{{StoryCite|story=The Levers of Power|book=The Rise of the Empire}}</ref> and other ships such as the ''[[Annihilator]]'',<ref name="Lost Stars">''[[Lost Stars]]''</ref> the [[Harbinger (Tector-class)|''Harbinger'']],<ref name="Starships of the Empire and the Rebellion">{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the Empire and the Rebellion}}</ref> the [[Subjugator (Star Destroyer)|''Subjugator'']],<ref name="Lost Stars" /> and the ''[[Vehement]]''.<ref name="Levers" /> Records of the briefings were kept by the ''Dark Omen''.<ref name="Rise" /> The Star Destroyer presence at Endor totaled over thirty.<ref name="OTFL">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref>

The battle started when the [[Rebel Alliance Navy]], consisting of various [[warship]]s arrived near the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]]. With the [[battle station]]'s [[Death Star's shield generator|shield generator]] still operational, the Imperial naval forces [[Battle of Endor|trapped]] the Alliance and deployed their starfighters while Imperial capital ships kept their distance and prevented the Alliance fleet from escaping. After a ground battle that destroyed the shield generator and a close-quarters naval action between Imperial and rebel capital ships, the Death Star II was destroyed<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> while [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and [[supreme commander of the Imperial fleet]] [[Sith Lord|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] were killed. Following the collapse of the command structure, Sloane aboard the ''Vigilance'' ordered a retreat.<ref name="Rise" />

===Defense of Kuat===
{{Quote|As it became apparent that the breakout was doomed, communications intensified between the ''Dark Omen'' and Moff Maksim and resulted in the surrender being issued.|Beaumont Kin on the final actions in the Defense of Kuat as written in ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise" />}}
[[File:B-wing_vs_Kuat_walkers.png|thumb|left|350px|The ''Dark Omen'' fought in the weeks-long Defense of Kuat.]]
With the Rebel Alliance [[Declaration of a New Republic|reorganizing]] as the [[New Republic]], the victors realized shortly after Endor that if their [[New Republic Defense Force|forces]] could at least blockade the [[Kuat shipyards]] or even capture it, then they would deprive the Empire of reinforcements and possibly shorten the war. Rae Sloane, now a Grand Admiral, dispatched reinforcements led by Ferno to the [[Kuat system]] to shore up Imperial defenses. Command of Imperial forces at Kuat generally fell to Moff [[Pollus Maksim]], but control of the fleet was taken by the ''Dark Omen''. The [[Defense of Kuat]] lasted for [[Standard week|weeks]] as the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] and Imperial forces initially attempted to hammer each other from long distances before the Republic incrementally pivoted to targeting vital sections of [[Kuat Drive Yards]] infrastructure such as [[fuel]] depots and supply [[monorail]]s. Fighting was usually strenuously attritional due to the strategy New Republic Admiral [[Gial Ackbar]] and Commodore [[Kyrsta Agate]] employed, as they attempted to force the Empire into defending as much as possible while weakening the [[shipyard]]s enough so that the Imperial fleet could not perform concurrent repairs.<ref name="Rise" />

Imperial vessels were captured and Star Destroyers defending the shipyards were actively cannibalized to provide more weapons to attack New Republic forces. Maksim and local [[Fleet Commander|fleet commanders]] had numerous discussions on whether they should continue defending the shipyards or if they should attempt to break out through the blockade and escape. The surviving ships attempted to escape while Maksim remained on<ref name="Rise" /> the [[factory world]]<ref name="DVG">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Kuat]], unwilling to put his life at risk on a Star Destroyer. The [[Kuati Imperial fleet|Imperial fleet's]] remnants moved into battle formation and readied to charge the New Republic. With the arrival of the [[Starhawk-class Battleship Mark I|''Starhawk''-class Battleship Mark I]] ''[[Concord]]'' preventing breaching any gaps in the New Republic's formation, communications between Maksim and the ''Dark Omen'' intensified and eventually a surrender was issued.<ref name="Rise" />

As a result, the shipyards fell to the New Republic, which captured the remains of seventeen Star Destroyers and an assortment of support ships. Ferno was [[Prisoner|imprisoned]], and the defeat at Kuat proved devastating to the Imperial war effort. With the most vital industrial center out of their control, morale collapsed across the Empire's forces and Sloane made contact with New Republic [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]] to [[Imperial–Republic peace talks|discuss]] possible peace terms. The failed Imperial defensive operation to protect the Kuat shipyards from the New Republic expedited the end of the war, which ended soon after with the [[Battle of Jakku]]<ref name="Rise" /> in [[5 ABY]].<ref name="Timelines" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Similarly, the initial attack on Atollon had been led by the tactically astute Captain Corf Ferno aboard the ''Dark Omen''. When Thrawn decided–unwisely–to lead the ground offensive, he could have returned command of the space battle to that ship.|Beaumont Kin provides his opinion of Thrawn's failures during Atollon in ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise" />}}
[[File:BeaumontKin-SWI207.png|thumb|right|250px|Historian Beaumont Kin wrote about Ferno and the ''Dark Omen'' in ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''.]]
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="RiseDate">{{RiseAndFallDate}}</ref> the [[historian]] and [[Resistance]] paramilitary member [[Beaumont Kin]] mentioned and cited the ''Dark Omen'' in several instances in<ref name="Rise" /> his<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''. The book contained an image of Thrawn<ref name="Rise" /> during his [[Exile (punishment)|exile]] on the planet [[Peridea]] in the [[far galaxy]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[9 ABY]]<ref name="Ahsoka Date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> that was recovered from the ''Dark Omen''. One record regarding the Seventh Fleet's reorganization following the disappearance of Thrawn was recovered from the ''Dark Omen'' and placed in the [[Imperial Archives]] Section: Fleet Compositions. The file was titled Seventh Fleet Reorganization.<ref name="Rise" />

A reference to records of the Endor briefing recovered from the ''Dark Omen'' and the wreckage of the ''Devastator'' and ''Steadfast'' was cited in the book. Two records from the ''Dark Omen'' regarding the Defense of Kuat were also recovered from the Imperial Archives Section: Imperial Navy Operations, specifically the Defense of Kuat–Command Hierarchy and Defense of Kuat–Force Power Projection. Data regarding the ''Dark Omen''{{'s}} role at the Derra IV ambush was recovered from the damaged [[computer core]] of the ISD ''Vigilance'' in a file titled "Derra IV." The file was placed in Imperial Archives: Section Military Operations. Kin likewise cited those records in his book.<ref name="Rise" />

==Commanders and crew==
===Atollon and Derra IV===
[[File:Dark-Omen-under-attack.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Dark Omen'' was led by Captain Corf Ferno during the Battle of Atollon.]]
The ''Dark Omen'' was part of the Seventh Fleet under the command of Grand Admiral Thrawn. Captain Corf Ferno served as the ship's commanding officer during the Battle of Atollon<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" /> and led the attack<ref name="Rise" /> despite Admiral Kassius Konstantine being placed in command of the Star Destroyer squadron's voyage to Atollon until Thrawn arrived. When Thrawn was planetside to oversee the ground attack against Chopper Base and Konstantine was [[Death|killed]], [[Governor of the Lothal sector|Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] of the Lothal sector commanded the entire Imperial fleet at Atollon.<ref name="Zero Hour" /> During the Imperial ambush in the Derra system, the ''Dark Omen'' was placed under Vice Admiral Rae Sloane's overall command as she led the action against the rebels.<ref name="Rise" />

===Endor and Kuat===
{{Quote|Command of the Empire’s forces at Kuat fell largely to Moff Pollus Maksim, though control of the fleet itself appears to have fallen to the ''Dark Omen''.|Beaumont Kin, in ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise" />}}
At Endor, the ''Dark Omen'' was directly commanded by Vice Admiral Ferno. Overall, Galactic Emperor Palpatine was the supreme leader of the Imperial forces and relayed orders to commanders, with Moff Tiaan Jerjerrod leading all Imperial forces. The Imperial naval detachment was led by Fleet Admiral Firmus Piett aboard the flagship ''Executor'', and all surviving Imperial fleet forces retreated once Vice Admiral Sloane gave the order.<ref name="Rise" />

Ferno and the ''Dark Omen'' continued to serve Sloane in her time as Grand Admiral. The ''Dark Omen'' fell under the overall command of Moff Pollus Maksim when it was dispatched by Sloane to bolster Imperial defenses, although Ferno's ''Dark Omen'' had control of the fleet.<ref name="Rise" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Dark Omen'' was first pictured in the mid-season trailer for the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' on [[January 4]], [[2017]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|upN-7ALj2OU|Star Wars Rebels Season 3 – Mid-Season Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/star-wars-rebels-season-three-mid-season-trailer-official}}</ref> The ship made its first appearance in "[[Zero Hour]],"<ref name="Zero Hour" /> the final episode of the season. The episode was released in two parts, the twenty-first and twenty-second episodes of the season overall, on [[March 25]], 2017.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|174|Star Wars Rebels Season Three Episode Guide|''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Three Episode Guide}}</ref> The ''Dark Omen'' received its name in the [[2021]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''.<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy" />
